emulate_int: emulate integer quantization on a tensor using a specified bit width and method
quantize: quantize a tensor using a given scale and zero point with clamping
emulate_int8_histogram: emulate 8-bit integer quantization using a histogram observer to compute scale and zero point
emulate_int8_channel: emulate per-channel 8-bit integer quantization using a min-max observer on the last axis
emulate_int8_tensor: emulate per-tensor 8-bit integer quantization using a min-max observer to compute scale and zero point
